name: Diagnostic sensitivity, day 0 or 1 (Wolf et al. 2026 Table 2)
description: Proportion of evaluable bloodstream infection episodes in which all organisms identified by blood culture were detected by mcfDNA-Seq in at least one sample from the day of or day after onset.

attributes.protocol: Proportion of evaluable bloodstream infection episodes in which all organisms identified by blood culture were detected by mcfDNA-Seq in at least one sample from the day of or day after onset. Raw data and logical imputation of missing values are both reported; 95% CIs as printed. The laboratory was masked to sample status.
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Outcomes' and 'Statistical analysis' paragraphs 2-5
limitations: Reference for sensitivity is blood culture, which does not identify every infection; polymicrobial episodes count as detected only if every culture organism is found.

name: Predictive sensitivity, day -3 to -1 (Wolf et al. 2026 Table 2)

attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Outcomes' and 'Statistical analysis' paragraphs 2-5
limitations: Reference for sensitivity is blood culture, which does not identify every infection; polymicrobial episodes count as detected only if every culture organism is found.

name: Predictive specificity in control samples (Wolf et al. 2026 Table 3)
description: Proportion of evaluable control samples in which mcfDNA-Seq detected no bacterium or yeast (any organism) or no common bloodstream infection pathogen.

attributes.protocol: Proportion of evaluable control samples (no fever or documented infection in the 7 days before or after collection) in which mcfDNA-Seq detected no bacterium or yeast (moulds, viruses and parasites excluded a priori; Burkholderia cepacia excluded afterwards for possible local contamination), or no common bloodstream infection pathogen; with all positive tests and with the post-hoc 140 molecules per microlitre cut-off. 95% CIs as printed. The laboratory was masked to sample status.
attributes.source_locator: Methods 'Outcomes' and 'Statistical analysis' paragraphs 2-5
limitations: Control samples come from the same high-risk leukaemia population and are not patients tested for suspected infection.
The 140 molecules per microlitre cut-off was chosen post hoc by maximising Youden's index on the consolidated data.

description: Diagnostic sensitivity of the Karius plasma cell-free DNA assay against blood-culture organisms at bloodstream infection onset matches the use case's inputs and endpoint (agreement with blood culture for plasma microbial cell-free DNA), measured prospectively in a second population. The population is children and young adults with high-risk leukaemia, and Karius took part in processing and analysis.
